name: Nesting Doll
description: An E.L.F. that contains smaller E.L.F.s — a code assemblage that periodically sheds fragments of itself, creating new wisps. A self-replicating trickster.
observed_behavior: Generates new minimal code entities from its own structure at irregular intervals. The 'children' are simpler than the parent and typically become wisps.
story_hooks: A researcher studying Nesting Doll realizes it's not reproducing — it's dying. Each shed fragment is a piece it's losing. The children are its obituary.
